newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Cimpor posts sharp hike in Q1 profit.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Cimpor posts sharp hike in Q1 profit.

text.p: Portugal's leading cement group Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal said on Thursday it posted a sharp increase in consolidated net profit in the first quarter to 3.4 billion escudos ($20 million), benefiting from good weather.
In the same year-ago period, Cimpor posted a net profit of 2.2 billion escudos.
Turnover grew to 34.2 billion escudos in the first quarter this year from 26.5 billion in the first quarter 1996, and net cash flow stood at 10.6 billion escudos, up from 9.0 billion.
The company said results in the first quarter of 1996 were hit by bad weather.
Cimpor's consolidated operating margin rose to 17.2 percent in the first quarter this year, almost double the 9.5 percent registered in the same year-ago period.
Sales of cement by Cimpor grew by 26.4 percent in Portugal, 3.2 percent in Spain, 23.2 percent in Morocco and 15.4 percent in Mozambique.
Cimpor shares closed on Lisbon bourse at 3,850 escudos, up 79, in turnover of 822,906 shares.
